_comment: Canonical catalog for the halvex dream campaign: 204 topics, 17 families. A-H are the original extraction-method topics; I-Q are technology-first topics (each 'hint' is a starting mapping hypothesis from the scouting run, for the dream to confirm, refute, or transcend); R-Y are infrastructure/product/practice topics. Families K/L/M (discovery sensors, standing queries, crawling) carry weight 2: the seeder's weighted round-robin gives them two slots per round so the owner's priority areas drain about twice as fast early in the campaign.

R.name: Market & reference data on a budget

topics.title: Weak supervision / programmatic labeling (Snorkel labeling functions over filings)
Distant supervision for relation extraction
Self-training / bootstrap loops (Hearst → DIPRE lineage)
Active learning for verification queues (which fact to check next)
Rule-learning / inductive logic programming for extraction rules
Synthetic data generation for extractor training/eval
Probabilistic record linkage (Fellegi–Sunter and successors)
Dedupe/blocking at scale (sorted-neighborhood, LSH candidate pairs)
NER + linking to authority files (issuer → CIK/LEI/ticker)
Cross-document coreference (same entity/deal across filings)
Transliteration & name normalization across scripts
Wikidata/OpenRefine reconciliation as a backbone
Document-AI table structure recognition
OCR pipelines & layout analysis for scanned disclosures
Segmentation/zoning of semi-structured documents
Font/visual-feature heuristics (bold = defined term)
Citation/reference parsing (GROBID/AnyStyle architecture)
Table understanding (column typing, header inference)
Wrapper induction & program synthesis for scrapers
Open information extraction (schema-free triples → normalize)
Structured prediction (CRFs) vs prompt-based extraction
Grammar-driven/declarative extraction languages (JAPE successors)
Constrained decoding / grammar-constrained generation for valid rows
Event extraction & event coreference (corporate events)
Slot filling (TAC-KBP knowledge-base-population methodology)
Temporal information extraction (event time vs report time)
Conformal prediction / uncertainty quantification on fields
Truth discovery / multi-source conflict resolution
Data fusion & source-trust scoring (Bleiholder/Naumann)
Fact/claim verification pipelines (FEVER lineage)
Textual entailment for evidence-support checking
Self-consistency / verification-by-sampling
Bayesian data cleaning / probabilistic databases
Extraction evaluation metrics beyond F1 (slot error rate)
Constraint-based joint inference (extractions must satisfy DB invariants)
Provenance-carrying extraction (every value ships its source span; PROV)
Schema matching & ontology alignment
RDF/SHACL shape validation as an extraction contract
Knowledge graph construction pipelines (Knowledge Vault lineage)
Datalog / deductive reasoning over extracted facts
Schema.org / microdata structured-data-on-the-web extraction
Web scraping robustness (anti-fragile selectors, drift detection)
Anti-bot / headless-browser rendering robustness (puppeteer)
Change data capture (CDC) for source monitoring
Web archiving & content drift (Memento/timegates)
Streaming/incremental extraction (extract-on-arrival)
Diff-based extraction (change detection between successive filings)
Retrieval-augmented extraction (retrieve exemplars at extraction time)
Multi-agent extraction (specialist extractors + reconciler)
Extraction cost cascades (cheap model first, expensive on disagreement)
Cost-aware LLM routing / model cascades
Test-time compute scaling (N-sample voting, verification passes)
Multilingual/cross-lingual extraction (EDINET/Japanese filings)
XBRL & structured regulatory reporting (when the source is already structured)
Model Context Protocol servers (typed tool/data plane for agents)
topics.hint: Wrapping monitor.db queries and EDGAR/EDINET/DART fetchers as MCP servers gives every Halvex extraction, dream, and dev agent one vetted, permissioned interface instead of ad-hoc bash-and-SQLite access.

topics.title: Agent Skills standard (SKILL.md packaged agent know-how)
topics.hint: Per-source tribal knowledge (EDINET quirks, DART auth, TDnet reading, MFN parsing) codified as versioned skills makes every spawned extraction agent consistent and reviewable across unattended runs.

topics.title: Kernel-primitive agent sandboxing (Landlock/bubblewrap least-privilege via @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime)
topics.hint: Dream runs and scraper agents fetching untrusted international IR pages could run under policies limited to monitor.db and whitelisted hosts, letting the owner raise autonomy without risking the canonical database.

topics.title: Durable execution engines (DBOS/Restate/Temporal checkpointed crash-resumable workflows)
topics.hint: Multi-step extraction jobs under systemd timers become exactly-once and crash-resumable, so a mid-run API failure never loses or double-writes facts nor re-pays for completed LLM steps.

topics.title: Beads (git-backed issue-graph memory for coding agents)
topics.hint: Dream runs could log leads, scraper breakages, and follow-ups as dependency-linked beads that the next Claude session queries instead of re-discovering state from markdown sprawl.

topics.title: Ralph technique (spec-anchored agent-in-a-while-loop with fresh context)
topics.hint: Halvex's dream-runner is structurally a Ralph loop, so the technique's conventions (fresh-context idempotency, progress ledgers, guardrail files) directly harden dream-runner.sh/queue.py.

topics.title: Decision-level LLM record/replay (VCR-cassette regression testing of agent trajectories)
topics.hint: Recording extraction-agent trajectories on known filings and replaying them deterministically gives zero-API-cost regression tests whenever prompts, parsers, or pipeline code change.

topics.title: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions (standardized tracing of LLM/agent runs)
topics.hint: Standard gen_ai spans across the extraction and dream pipelines turn debugging a wrong fact in monitor.db from log-grepping into a trace query pinpointing the document, prompt, and tool call responsible.

topics.title: Inspect AI (trajectory-level agent evaluation framework)
topics.hint: Scoring whole extraction trajectories — right filing fetched, right tool sequence, number grounded in the document — reveals where agents fail procedurally, not just in final answers.

topics.title: Spec-driven development toolchains (OpenSpec/Spec Kit repo-resident specs as source of truth)
topics.hint: Driving new source adapters and schema changes through version-controlled specs suits the unattended-dream workflow where the spec is the durable artifact the human reviews.

topics.title: Graphiti-style bi-temporal knowledge-graph agent memory (valid-time plus transaction-time fact edges)
topics.hint: Holdings facts are inherently bi-temporal, so a Graphiti-style layer lets agents recall what was known when, catch contradictions across filings, and accumulate weak discovery signals across dream runs.

topics.title: VLM computer-use browser agents (screenshot-and-click operation of UIs without APIs)
topics.hint: JS-heavy or form-gated IR portals of small international issuers could be periodically visited by a computer-use agent to spot new bitcoin-treasury disclosures no feed covers.

topics.title: Open deep-research harnesses (plan-search-fetch-verify loops producing cited reports)
topics.hint: A scheduled harness running queries like 'company adds bitcoin to treasury' across non-English press could systematically surface new treasury companies earlier than feed-based monitoring.

topics.title: BAML schema-aligned parsing (typed LLM-function DSL with output repair)
topics.hint: Declaring fact schemas (holdings, dates, units) once as typed, unit-tested LLM functions yields robust parses even from cheap models, cutting retries and JSON-mangling bugs.

topics.title: Text diffusion LLMs (parallel denoising decoders with 5-10x throughput)
topics.hint: High-volume low-difficulty triage of thousands of news items and filings could move to diffusion models for order-of-magnitude cheaper and faster screening.

topics.title: LLMLingua prompt compression (task-preserving token pruning up to 20x)
topics.hint: Compressing long filings and news bundles before extraction calls cuts per-document token cost without the accuracy loss of naive truncation or chunking.

topics.title: Semantic entropy probes (meaning-level uncertainty detection of confabulations)
topics.hint: An uncertainty score on each extracted BTC amount or date could gate whether a fact auto-commits to monitor.db or routes to second-pass verification.

topics.title: ColPali late-interaction visual retrieval (OCR-free semantic search over PDF page images)
topics.hint: Japanese and Korean filings could be indexed as page images and queried for bitcoin-holdings content, surfacing candidate pages for extraction without brittle text pipelines.

topics.title: Combinatorial group testing (Dorfman pooled screening with bisection of positives)
topics.hint: Pooling many small filings into single 'does ANY of these mention crypto-asset holdings?' Claude calls and bisecting only positive pools cuts screening token cost by a large factor since relevant documents are rare.

topics.title: SetFit (contrastive few-shot fine-tuning of small sentence-embedding classifiers)
topics.hint: Halvex's verified facts double as free labels for local SetFit relevance/document-type gates that run on every inbound document at zero marginal cost.

topics.title: x402 protocol (HTTP 402 stablecoin micropayments for agent API access)
topics.hint: Pay-per-call access to premium disclosure or market-data endpoints, instead of subscriptions, could fill coverage gaps in exactly the small international markets Halvex targets on a limited budget.

topics.title: BIS Project Gaia architecture (central-bank blueprint for LLM KPI extraction from heterogeneous reports)
topics.hint: Gaia solved nearly Halvex's exact problem at central-bank scale, and its published choices on indicator definitions, chunk retrieval, and validation transplant directly to BTC-holding extraction.

topics.title: Common Crawl CC-NEWS (free continuous multilingual news WARC stream)
topics.hint: A batch scanner over daily CC-NEWS WARCs grepping treasury phrases in 30+ languages could surface small international companies' coverage days before regulator feeds.

topics.title: Common Crawl columnar index + host web graph (serverless SQL over crawl metadata)
topics.hint: SQL over the Parquet URL index plus link-graph expansion from known treasury-company IR sites enumerates candidate companies and IR endpoints at near-zero fetch cost, including retrospective multilingual sweeps.

topics.title: GDELT GKG + Web News NGrams (15-minute global news knowledge graph in 100+ languages)
topics.hint: Standing queries over organization-plus-crypto-theme combinations act as a free global early-warning layer for treasury adopters in countries where Halvex has no filing feed.

topics.title: Certificate Transparency log streaming (real-time sensor for new domains and certificates)
topics.hint: Watching CT streams for bitcoin/treasury naming patterns and new IR subdomains reveals renamed shells launching treasury vehicles days before any filing or press release exists.

topics.title: ICANN CZDS zone-file diffing (newly-registered-domain feeds with lexical permutation matching)
topics.hint: Daily zone diffs for domains containing treasury/bitcoin tokens or permutations of tracked company names is a near-zero-cost sensor for corporate pivots that predates press releases.

topics.title: AT Protocol Jetstream (filterable JSON firehose of the Bluesky network)
topics.hint: Filtering posts for treasury-announcement language and cashtags catches the social echo of small-cap announcements hours before news aggregators index them.

topics.title: Nostr relay subscriptions (server-side filtered streams of a bitcoin-native social network)
topics.hint: The bitcoin-treasury community is disproportionately active on Nostr, so cheap filtered relay subscriptions surface rumors of obscure international adopters that never reach mainstream feeds.

topics.title: Wikimedia EventStreams (real-time SSE firehose of Wikipedia/Wikidata edits)
topics.hint: Edits adding bitcoin-holdings claims to company articles are crowd-sourced discovery signals, with the edit's cited source as a free evidence lead for untracked companies.

topics.title: Stract/Marginalia self-hosted search (open web indexes with custom ranking DSLs)
topics.hint: Scripted queries with an 'optic' boosting IR pages, regulatory portals, and small-cap news sites give repeatable, rate-limit-free discovery queries no commercial search API allows.

topics.title: ESMA FIRDS/FITRS (free bulk EU instrument reference data keyed by LEI)
topics.hint: Diffing the free universe of all EU-listed instruments detects new listings, name changes, and delistings of small European companies before they appear in news, feeding discovery.

topics.title: European Single Access Point (single machine-readable feed of all EU listed-company disclosures, 2026-2028)
topics.hint: One free upcoming feed could replace much per-country Nordic/EU scraping and surface small EU treasury companies the day they file; building an ingest path now is a first-mover coverage play.

topics.title: WebSub (W3C push protocol replacing feed polling)
topics.hint: IR blogs and newsroom CMSes exposing WebSub hubs could deliver treasury announcements minutes after publication while freeing polling budget for hub-less sources.

topics.title: EASM-style asset enumeration (Amass/passive-DNS discovery of an organization's web estate)
topics.hint: Pointing subdomain and related-domain enumeration at watchlist companies auto-discovers IR feeds, disclosure endpoints, and post-rebrand domains without manual hunting, especially for Japanese/Korean/Nordic issuers.

topics.title: Event-Based Surveillance methodology (epidemiology's signal-triage-verify pipeline for open media)
topics.hint: Discovery of un-filed international treasury companies is structurally EBS for corporate bitcoin adoption, so the signal, verification, and characterization workflow ports wholesale.

topics.title: Watch-only output descriptors + mempool monitoring (minutes-level detection of movements on known wallets)
topics.hint: Maintaining descriptors for attributed corporate wallets detects accumulation, custodian migration, or sales within minutes of broadcast, often days before the press release.

topics.title: Positive-Unlabeled learning (training detectors from positives plus an unlabeled pool)
topics.hint: Known treasury companies are a clean positive set and every other listed company in 33 countries is unlabeled, so a PU model can rank the world's public companies by likelihood of being an undiscovered holder.

topics.title: First Story Detection (DARPA TDT streaming novelty detection over news)
topics.hint: FSD over multilingual feeds surfaces the first-ever announcement of a treasury adoption while suppressing hundreds of follow-up articles, at near-zero LLM cost.

topics.title: Adaptive information filtering (TREC standing-query profiles with utility-tuned thresholds)
topics.hint: Halvex is literally a standing query over document streams, and adaptive-filtering utility optimization gives principled per-source thresholds for what escalates to expensive LLM extraction.

topics.title: Personalized PageRank seed expansion (random-walk ranking outward from known-good nodes)
topics.hint: PPR from known treasury companies over a graph of co-mentions, shared directors, custodians, and investors ranks candidates likely to announce next — a discovery channel orthogonal to keywords.

topics.title: Knowledge-graph embedding link prediction (PyKEEN scoring of plausible missing edges)
topics.hint: Link prediction over a graph of companies, sectors, advisors, custodians, and existing holders yields a prioritized watchlist of likely future bitcoin-treasury adopters.

topics.title: Risk-based alerting (SIEM pattern accumulating weighted signals per entity until a threshold fires)
topics.hint: Accumulating weak signals per company — crypto hires, rebrand, convertible raise, BTC mentions — surfaces small international candidates for agent investigation before any explicit filing.

topics.title: Frequent episode mining (WINEPI/MINEPI recurring event patterns in one long stream)
topics.hint: Mining corporate-event history for episodes that historically precede a first bitcoin purchase yields an early-warning pattern library for companies about to adopt.

topics.title: Reverse search / percolation (Lucene Monitor matching documents against thousands of stored queries)
topics.hint: Registering per-company and per-pattern standing queries and streaming every fetched item through them replaces ad-hoc grep logic with a scalable, auditable alerting core.

topics.title: Embedding-based streaming filters (documents scored against fixed intent vectors)
topics.hint: A tiny local embedding model scoring every headline against 'company adds bitcoin to balance sheet' vectors pre-filters firehoses and catches paraphrases like 'digital asset reserve strategy' that keywords miss.

topics.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (robust unsupervised merging of heterogeneous ranked lists)
topics.hint: RRF fuses Halvex's accumulating weak detectors — keyword hits, PU scores, graph proximity, news bursts — into one prioritized review queue without calibrated scores or training data.

topics.title: Entity salience detection (scoring whether a mention is central or passing)
topics.hint: A cheap salience scorer discards the flood of articles where a tracked company is only name-dropped, routing only articles where it is the actual subject to extraction.

topics.title: YARA-X content rules (high-throughput weighted pattern scanning from malware triage)
topics.hint: Versioned multilingual treasury-pattern rules scan every downloaded filing in microseconds as a pre-LLM gate, cutting token spend while keeping recall auditable.

topics.title: MISP warninglists (versioned false-positive suppression lists)
topics.hint: Suppression lists for miners, ETFs, custodians, and 'accepts bitcoin as payment' companies turn tribal false-positive knowledge into reviewable versioned data checked before a candidate enters the watchlist.

topics.title: Focused topical crawling (best-first crawlers concentrating budget on on-topic pages)
topics.hint: A focused crawler seeded on IR and crypto-treasury vocabulary sweeps small-cap exchange and IR domains in markets without structured filing APIs — Halvex's hardest coverage gap.

topics.title: LLM-scored crawl frontiers (Craw4LLM-style link prioritization by a cheap model)
topics.hint: A Haiku-scored frontier asking 'does this link plausibly lead to bitcoin-holdings evidence?' makes a discovery crawler dramatically more precise per fetched page under the limited budget.

topics.title: Multi-armed bandit poll scheduling (Thompson sampling over sources with unknown yield)
topics.hint: Treating each of hundreds of feeds as an arm whose reward is 'yielded a new fact' lets Thompson sampling set polling frequency under the API budget instead of fixed systemd cadences.

topics.title: Change-rate-aware recrawl scheduling (Cho/Garcia-Molina freshness models per source)
topics.hint: Fitting per-source change-rate models reallocates the same request budget so disclosure-heavy sources get minutes-level polling and dormant ones weekly, detecting announcements sooner.

topics.title: Crawl4AI (Playwright crawler emitting clean token-efficient Markdown for LLMs)
topics.hint: Replacing ad-hoc fetch-plus-cleanup steps in per-issuer IR scrapers cuts tokens sent to Claude and improves accuracy on messy international IR pages.

topics.title: Crawlee (TypeScript crawling framework with persistent queues, retries, session pools)
topics.hint: Being TypeScript-native, it gives Halvex's dozens of per-source fetchers a shared restartable request-queue and retry substrate instead of bespoke polling scripts.

topics.title: TLS/HTTP2 fingerprint impersonation (curl_cffi presenting browser JA3/JA4 handshakes)
topics.hint: Fingerprint-sensitive Korean, Japanese, and Nordic CDN-fronted endpoints become fetchable with cheap plain HTTP instead of escalating to a full browser.

topics.title: RSSHub / RSS-Bridge (community-maintained feed synthesis for feedless sites)
topics.hint: Normalizing feedless international IR pages and Asian financial portals into uniform feeds collapses many bespoke scrapers into one ingestion path across 33 countries.

topics.title: changedetection.io-style page monitoring (self-hosted watchers firing on real content change)
topics.hint: A cheap watchdog over hundreds of small-cap IR pages wakes a Claude extraction agent only when a page actually changed, saving API budget and catching disclosures sooner.

topics.title: Katana (security-recon crawler mapping hidden endpoints via hybrid static+headless crawling)
topics.hint: Mapping an issuer's entire IR site once — hidden PDF endpoints, JSON APIs behind JS — yields a complete fetch target list instead of only the visible news page.

topics.title: Web Bot Auth (IETF signed-request identity for well-behaved crawlers)
topics.hint: A signed, registered Halvex crawler identity keeps legitimate access to Cloudflare/Akamai-fronted IR sites as anti-bot walls tighten across the 33 covered countries.

topics.title: DuckDB sqlite_scanner (in-process columnar analytics directly over SQLite files)
topics.hint: Heavy cross-company analytics, QA sweeps, and site projection queries run vectorized against monitor.db without changing the canonical store.

topics.title: sqlite-vec (zero-dependency vector search inside SQLite)
topics.hint: Embeddings of filings, news, and company names living inside monitor.db enable semantic dedupe, alias matching, and 'looks like a treasury disclosure' screening with no new infrastructure.

topics.title: SQLite Session extension (portable row-level changesets that can be inspected, inverted, merged)
topics.hint: Parallel Claude agents each produce a changeset against a snapshot, letting the pipeline review, replay, roll back, or merge agent writes deterministically instead of allowing direct mutation.

topics.title: cr-sqlite (CRDT tables enabling conflict-free multi-writer SQLite merges)
topics.hint: Multiple unattended agents or machines write to their own monitor.db replica and merge deterministically, removing write-lock contention for parallel agent fleets.

topics.title: Turso (Rust SQLite rewrite with async I/O, concurrent writes, deterministic simulation testing)
topics.hint: A file-compatible drop-in that removes single-writer bottlenecks when many systemd jobs and Claude agents hit monitor.db, with native vector queries as a bonus.

topics.title: Branchable git-semantics databases (Dolt/TerminusDB branch, row-level diff, merge)
topics.hint: Every unattended agent run becomes a branch with a cheap reviewable row-level diff before merge, catching bad extractions before they pollute the canonical database.

topics.title: Feldera / DBSP (incremental evaluation of SQL views from input deltas)
topics.hint: Site-facing aggregates and derived tables update incrementally as new filings land, replacing cron-style full recomputes and cutting filing-to-site latency.

topics.title: DuckLake (Parquet lakehouse with catalog metadata in a plain SQL database)
topics.hint: Raw filings, extraction runs, and historical snapshots get time-travel queries ('what did we believe about company X on date D') with a SQLite-backed catalog matching the solo-dev stack.

topics.title: Kuzu (embedded SQLite-style property-graph database with Cypher)
topics.hint: An entity-relationship sidecar graph (subsidiaries, shared officers, custodians) supports cheap multi-hop queries revealing hidden connections between known holders and undiscovered vehicles.

topics.title: QLever (single-machine SPARQL over Wikidata-scale local dumps)
topics.hint: A local Wikidata/registry dump gives unlimited-budget entity enrichment and candidate sweeps (all listed companies in a country with recent name changes) without rate-limited public APIs.

topics.title: Malloy (semantic modeling language compiling reusable metrics to SQL)
topics.hint: One governed definition of 'BTC per share' or 'coverage freshness' is reused identically by the website projection, QA checks, and agent-generated analyses instead of duplicated SQL.

topics.title: Dagster software-defined assets (declarative freshness-driven orchestration)
topics.hint: Systemd-timer scripts reframed as declared assets with freshness policies let re-extraction be driven by staleness rather than hand-wired schedules.

topics.title: SQLMesh (virtual environments with semantic understanding of SQL changes)
topics.hint: Derivation SQL over monitor.db evolves in a cheap shadow environment and is semantically diffed against production before promotion — safe change management with no staging infra.

topics.title: dlt (declarative extract-load with automatic schema inference and drift surfacing)
topics.hint: The 33-country zoo of registry APIs and IR feeds lands in consistently normalized staging tables with almost no per-source glue code, with schema drift surfaced automatically.

topics.title: Nuclei template convention (declarative YAML request/matcher/extractor definitions run by one engine)
topics.hint: Per-registry and per-issuer scrapers recast as reviewable YAML templates make adding a new country's disclosure endpoint a data change rather than new TypeScript.

topics.title: Open Data Contract Standard (machine-checkable YAML contracts for datasets and pipeline boundaries)
topics.hint: Each source ingester and each Claude extraction output carries a contract validated before facts merge into monitor.db, turning implicit expectations about agent output into enforced interfaces.

topics.title: Pointblank (expectation suites over tables with human-readable quality reports)
topics.hint: Suites asserting holdings monotonicity, sane BTC quantities, and cross-table consistency run after each pipeline pass and emit a skimmable report before the site serves the data.

topics.title: Write-Audit-Publish pattern (stage, audit, then atomically publish data)
topics.hint: Agent-extracted facts land in staging, pass invariant checks and a verifier agent, and only then swap atomically into the tables the read-only website projects.

topics.title: Baked Data architecture (immutable versioned database files shipped per deploy)
topics.hint: Publishing the site as content-addressed monitor.db snapshots makes every published state reproducible and rollbackable, cleanly decoupling pipeline writes from what readers see.

topics.title: Metamorphic testing (asserting invariance relations across perturbed inputs, no oracle needed)
topics.hint: Perturbing filings — reorder sections, translate, rename the company — and asserting extracted facts stay invariant exposes brittle prompts cheaply without hand-labeled gold answers.

topics.title: XULE / XBRL DQC rules engine (declarative data-quality assertion library the SEC itself runs)
topics.hint: Adopting the declarative-assertion pattern (or running DQC rules in Arelle) turns extraction QA — sign conventions, unit errors, impossible deltas — into a maintained rule library.

topics.title: SPOT/DSPOT (extreme-value-theory streaming anomaly thresholds without labels)
topics.hint: Statistically principled tail thresholds flag implausible extracted values — a BTC holdings jump or outlier cost basis — as extraction errors or genuine news, replacing hand-tuned sanity bounds.

topics.title: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection (streaming regime-change detection via run-length posteriors)
topics.hint: Applied to per-company signal streams and per-source health metrics, BOCPD flags companies whose behavior shifts pre-announcement and feeds that silently broke.

topics.title: Jidoka / andon (stop-the-line semantics on detected abnormality)
topics.hint: Any anomalous extraction — holdings jump 10x, negative shares, unknown currency — halts publication for that source and raises a visible cord-pull instead of best-effort continuing.

topics.title: LinkML (one YAML model compiled to SQL DDL, JSON Schema, and typed classes)
topics.hint: Defining the canonical fact model once generates both the SQLite DDL and the strict JSON contracts extraction agents must emit, eliminating schema drift between database, agents, and website.

topics.title: OCSF (extensible event-class taxonomy normalizing heterogeneous telemetry)
topics.hint: Its class/profile/extension design normalizes the 33-country zoo of disclosure events (8-K, TDnet kaiji, DART, MFN) into one canonical taxonomy with per-source extension fields.

topics.title: SKOS concept schemes (controlled vocabularies with multilingual alt-labels and mappings)
topics.hint: Filing types and disclosure event kinds managed as SKOS schemes with Japanese/Korean/Nordic altLabels let agents map local-language terminology to one canonical concept ID.

topics.title: FIBO (formal OWL ontology of financial entities, instruments, and control)
topics.hint: Borrowing FIBO's tested definitions of issuer, subsidiary, and control tightens who-'holds'-BTC semantics when a subsidiary or trust does, across 33 jurisdictions.

topics.title: FollowTheMoney 4.0 (statement-based entity model where every property value is a sourced, dated assertion)
topics.hint: FtM's battle-tested statement layer — entities as merges of sourced assertions — is directly adoptable for evidence-backed company facts, with a reusable cleaning toolchain.

topics.title: FINOS Common Domain Model (machine-executable lifecycle-event model of financial products)
topics.hint: Modeling purchases, sales, pledges, and custody changes as typed lifecycle events whose fold is current state makes the holdings ledger auditable and computable rather than snapshot-based.

topics.title: ACTUS (algorithmic contract types deterministically generating cash-flow obligations)
topics.hint: Encoding the convertibles and preferreds that finance BTC purchases as ACTUS types computes dilution and conversion triggers from extracted terms instead of storing prose.

topics.title: ISO 24165 Digital Token Identifier (canonical registry IDs for digital assets)
topics.hint: Using DTIs as the asset key future-proofs the schema against 'bitcoin' ambiguity (forks, wrapped variants) and aligns with MiCA-era European disclosures.

topics.title: OpenFIGI (free open instrument symbology with a public mapping service)
topics.hint: A canonical free way to disambiguate small international tickers across 33 countries' exchanges and detect venue changes without paid market-data APIs.

topics.title: Rules as Code (disclosure obligations encoded as executable logic)
topics.hint: Encoding each jurisdiction's disclosure triggers lets Halvex predict when a suspected treasury company MUST file and flag overdue or evaded disclosures.

topics.title: KGCL (typed, reviewable change operations on a knowledge base)
topics.hint: Agents propose corrections as typed change operations ('update holding of X from N to M citing filing F') instead of raw SQL, giving a reviewable, replayable edit stream for unattended runs.

topics.title: OpenTimestamps (Bitcoin-anchored proofs that data existed at time T)
topics.hint: Timestamping every fetched filing and extracted-fact batch gives cryptographic 'we saw this disclosure at time T' evidence for first-observed dates — anchored, fittingly, in Bitcoin itself.

topics.title: in-toto attestations (signed chain-of-custody metadata across pipeline steps)
topics.hint: Each stage — fetch, parse, LLM extract, load — emits attestations binding output hashes to input documents, prompt versions, and agent identity, making every number traceable to a signed chain.

topics.title: WACZ signed web archives (tamper-evident replayable page captures)
topics.hint: Storing a signed WACZ alongside each extracted fact makes the 'evidence-backed' claim literal: replayable snapshots of filings and IR pages that later disappear or change.

topics.title: ISCC (ISO content codes combining similarity matching and byte-integrity in one identifier)
topics.hint: One identifier per ingested document simultaneously detects re-published mirrors of the same disclosure across 33 countries' feeds and proves byte-integrity of stored evidence.

topics.title: ETSI AdES validation (verifying digital signatures embedded in regulatory PDFs/XML)
topics.hint: Many EDINET, DART, and EU documents already carry embedded signatures; validating at ingest distinguishes authentic regulator-signed filings from tampered mirrors for free confidence uplift.

topics.title: immudb (embedded append-only database with Merkle inclusion/consistency proofs)
topics.hint: A verifiable ledger beside monitor.db lets the site prove a holdings number was never quietly rewritten, making corrections auditable rather than destructive.

topics.title: Nanopublications (atomic signed assertion + provenance + publication-info units)
topics.hint: Each fact — 'Metaplanet held 3,350 BTC on date D per disclosure H' — is exactly a nanopub; the tripartite structure makes facts independently citable, verifiable, and supersedable.

topics.title: STIX sighting objects (each independent observation of a claim recorded first-class)
topics.hint: Modeling every independent appearance of a claim (filing, TDnet notice, article) as a sighting on the canonical fact gives principled corroboration counts and first-seen/last-seen instead of overwriting evidence.

topics.title: MISP decaying indicators (parametric confidence decay reset by fresh sightings)
topics.hint: Every stored fact gets a decaying confidence that re-inflates when a fresh filing re-confirms it, so the pipeline knows which companies' data is stale and prioritizes re-verification under budget.

topics.title: GRADE framework (named upgrade/downgrade criteria for evidence certainty)
topics.hint: Grading each fact by source directness, consistency, and staleness gives the website a principled, defensible certainty label instead of ad-hoc confidence.

topics.title: Forecaster calibration practice (Brier-scoring stated confidences against outcomes)
topics.hint: Logging LLM confidence versus later-verified correctness per source and prompt builds calibration curves that turn arbitrary model confidences into trustworthy review-prioritization signals.

topics.title: W3C Web Annotation / stand-off annotation (extractions as a separate layer over immutable source text)
topics.hint: Facts stored as stand-off annotations over pristine filing text let multiple extractor versions layer over the same spans and represent competing extractions explicitly.

topics.title: BIP-322 signing & proof-of-reserves attestations (cryptographic demonstrations of BTC control and solvency)
topics.hint: Parsing and independently re-verifying PoR attestations upgrades holdings facts from 'company said' to 'cryptographically verified' and flags discrepancies with filings.

topics.title: On-chain address clustering (common-input-ownership and change heuristics grouping corporate wallets)
topics.hint: From one disclosed address, clustering expands to the company's full wallet footprint, corroborating claimed holdings and detecting unannounced buys or sales from balance changes.

topics.title: GraphSense TagPacks (YAML standard for provenance-carrying address-to-actor attribution)
topics.hint: Curating company-to-wallet attributions as versioned, sourced TagPack files enables systematic cross-checking of disclosed BTC holdings against on-chain balances.
